season: Game 1.4.002 (2026-09-23): plating to 25 with shatter restore, Gnome Lab to 110-2, the stage easing and the Dimensional Rift
lede: What raises the team power (전투력) Cookie Run: Crumble shows for a lineup, what each source costs free and paid, how much power it gave players who posted before/after numbers, and the order to spend in at each account stage. Power matters because stages and the Dimensional Rift cut damage in steps below a stage's recommended power (record 003).
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-28. Posted gains are few and from DCInside: the game has no public power formula, and the guild lab's +20% is a single unmeasured claim. KR prices are from the KR shop and the KR App Store; USD prices only where the US App Store lists the same package. Crystal values rank package contents, not team power.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.

you.summary: At about 2.2G your stage preset reaches 55% to 288-3 and 35% to 304-19, and every +0.2G moves the 35% line about three to four chapters; 328-30 at 35% needs 4.00G. The free levers that move a 2.2G team fastest are the guild (a research-13 guild is claimed at about +20%), a pure-power stage preset, and the next Stellar Link points on constellation 8 (+10% for one step at 2G). Paid, the best power per KRW is Stellar Points for the newest constellation and keeping the weekly key set and the Crumble Pass going; plating and TSSR stars are the whale lane and buy little power per KRW past 15 and 5★.
changes: Confirm your guild's research level; if it is well below the top guilds' 13–14, a stronger guild is the largest free step on record (unverified claim).
Keep a separate stage preset rolled for displayed power (crit resistance and other padding lines, SSR rune lines that add power) and swap to it when a bracket line is within a few %.
Open the next constellation-8 points (cookie stars) and shape them: one step was worth +10% at 2G, about 304-19 → 308 at 35%.
Put Gnome Lab stones into HP 30% and the ATK nodes; the 2G → 4G player credits research most.
Plate the sword and bow toward 20 with Syrup for protection and restores; expect 2% per try at 19→20.
Buy Stellar Points before plating packs or TSSR stars if spending; don't chase 100% (95% is the practical end).

team_power.lede: Team power growth: every system that raises displayed team power, with its cost, cap, posted gains and the spending order by account stage.
team_power.caveat: Displayed power weights stats unevenly (attack types and missing stats count more), so power is a gate for stages and the Rift, not a measure of strength in Arena or Guild Conquest.

rules.title: Where team power counts
rules.body: Only stages and the Dimensional Rift compare team power with a recommended power (the damage brackets of record 003); in Arena and Guild Conquest the number decides nothing and options matter instead.

rules.title: Team power versus account total
rules.body: Team power (팀투, 덱투, 파티투력) is the lineup's figure the gate uses; the account total (총투) sums every cookie and is what crumb.gg's combat power board shows (10.6G–33.4G for the top 500 on 2026-09-28).

rules.title: Arena excludes some sources
rules.body: Arena applies cookie level and promotion, pet holding effects, the collection, gear, plating and sugar runes, but not Resolve, Stellar Link, the Gnome Lab, the guild lab or Fame.
